description: Main window: core:default, plus start_dragging for the web bundle's data-tauri-drag-region top bars (#2671), plus the read-only permission probe the notification plugin's page script sends at every launch (#2676), plus one grant per app command. The build declares an app ACL manifest (build.rs, #2772), so an app command without a grant here is refused. The PTY commands are not here: they live in pty.json.
